shared_elements: upright stone slab/monolith with rounded top carved in low relief
incised linear surface decoration organized in horizontal registers/bands
curved or arched line spanning the upper part of the field
small repeated schematic motifs arranged in a row
justification: Both are shaped upright slabs bearing shallow incised linear ornament arranged in horizontal zones, with an arching line across the upper field, but that is about as far as it goes. A depicts a clearly readable scene — a sailing ship with mast, rigging, a hull with rows of shields/crew and a zigzag-filled sail — while B shows an abstract anthropomorphic block with a head, a shoulder band of curvilinear/spiral-like motifs, paired round bosses and a belt-like ridge, with no vessel, no figures and no comparable narrative scene.
